title: 第二十三章 必须给他搅黄了第二十四章 好戏开场
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
：回家的路上，唐斩月为了扭转自己的形象，详细讲述了这段时间她打脸那几个渣男贱女的事。
虞倾凰越听越满意，当即表示：“我的宝贝终于长大了，等妈妈休息两天，参加完言老头的寿宴，带你去会所点他十个八个男模！”
唐斩月有些心动，但还不等答应，唐渊就否定了这个提议。
“不行，斩月已经有了新的接触对象，是叶家的叶峥，你之前不是觉得他不错吗？”
虞倾凰眨眨眼，“那孩子呀。”她遗憾叹气，“那就等你跟叶峥掰了再说。”
唐斩月：“……好的，妈妈。”
可怜的叶峥，还没上位就先承担起了下岗的风险。
唐渊暗自松了口气，顺势提起另一件事，“你打算去言老头的寿宴？”
虞倾凰勾唇一笑，“长辈的邀请，多少要给点面子。”
唐渊哼笑，“你是嫌人家寿宴不够热闹吧。”
虞倾凰不置可否，转头吩咐：“月月跟我一起去。”
唐斩月立马应下，多么完美的一个舞台啊，大家齐聚在一起，不搞点事都对不起那么多观众。
到家后，唐渊和虞倾凰就回自己房间了，说是旅途劳累，需要休息，到底在干什么就只有他们自己清楚。
唐斩月摇着头去了餐厅，让小D给她弄了杯果汁，然后一边喝一边回想刚刚的表现。
没见面之前她一直很紧张，尤其是被妈妈嫌弃的时候，诋毁人的话几乎脱口而出，简直机智得一匹。
之后紧张感就消失了，随之而来的是本能的亲近，甚至因此变得有些谄媚。
好像十几年的分离完全不存在一样，妈妈跟她记忆中一样漂亮，只是性格变得更飒了。
唐斩月忍不住笑，一家三口终于团聚了，生活也是越来越有盼头了。
她一口干了杯里的果汁，挽起袖子走进厨房，“小D，家里有什么食材都拿出来，晚饭我来准备。”
她要亲手给爸妈做顿饭，这是她曾经幻想过无数次的场景。

唐斩月用出毕生所学，加上满满的爱意，做出了美味的三菜一汤，然后等了整整三个小时，等来了小D说主人不出来吃饭的消息。
唐斩月沉默，唐斩月悲愤，唐斩月怒吃三菜一汤！
果然，在爸妈眼里，她就是个意外！
唐斩月吃撑了，但她今天没有心情运动，洗漱后往床上一摊，很快就昏昏欲睡。
再睁眼，已经到了第二天早上。
大概是多年心愿终于达成，唐斩月状态前所未有的好，给叶峥回早安的消息时，还附赠了一张花园照片。
叶峥敏锐地察觉到了她的心情，趁着训练前的几分钟，给她打来通讯。
唐斩月秒接，根本不在乎自己连脸都没洗。
叶峥看着她发光的眼睛，微勾的唇角，越发肯定了自己的猜测，“发生什么好事了？”
唐斩月歪头笑，“实现了一个心愿。”她不想多谈，顺口问道：“你在军部？”
“嗯，半个月后我就要回前线了。”叶峥很是不舍，“晚上一起吃饭？”
唐斩月欣然应道：“好啊。”
叶峥神色温柔，“晚上见，月月。”
唐斩月下楼时，不出意外的，仍旧不见爸妈人影，但她心态平和多了，自己吃完早餐，在苏苗和许枫的护送下去上班了。
content_en:
: On the way home, in order to change her image, Tang Zhanyue told in detail the things she had slapped in the faces of those scumbag men and women during this period.
The more Yu Qinghuang listened, the more satisfied she became, and she immediately said: "My baby has finally grown up. When mom has two days of rest and attends Old Man Yan's birthday party, I will take you to the club to order ten or eight of his male models!"
Tang Zhanyue was a little moved, but before he could agree, Tang Yuan rejected the proposal.
"No, Zangyue has already made contact with a new person, Ye Zheng from the Ye family. Didn't you think he was good before?"
Yu Qinghuang blinked, "That kid." She sighed regretfully, "Then we'll wait until you and Ye Zheng break up."
Tang Zhanyue: "...Okay, mom."
Poor Ye Zheng took the risk of being laid off before he even took up the position.
Tang Yuan secretly breathed a sigh of relief and brought up another matter, "Are you planning to go to the old man's birthday party?"
Yu Qinghuang raised her lips and smiled, "Invitations from elders require some respect."
Tang Yuan chuckled, "You think my birthday party isn't lively enough."
Yu Qinghuang did not comment, turned around and ordered: "Yueyue come with me."
Tang Zhanyue immediately agreed. What a perfect stage. Everyone is gathered together. If you don't do something, you will be sorry for so many viewers.
After arriving home, Tang Yuan and Yu Qinghuang went back to their rooms, saying that they were tired from the journey and needed to rest. Only they knew what they were doing.
Tang Zhanyue shook his head and went to the restaurant, asking Xiao D to get her a glass of juice, and then drank while thinking about her performance just now.
She had always been very nervous before they met, especially when she was disliked by her mother. She almost blurted out slanderous words, and she was so witty.
Then the tension disappeared, and an instinctive closeness followed, even becoming a bit flattering as a result.
It was as if the separation of more than ten years did not exist at all. Her mother was as beautiful as she remembered, but her personality became more sassy.
Tang Zhanyue couldn't help but laugh. The family of three was finally reunited, and life was becoming more and more promising.
She drank the juice in the glass in one gulp, rolled up her sleeves and walked into the kitchen, "Little D, bring out all the ingredients you have at home. I'll prepare dinner."
She wanted to cook a meal for her parents with her own hands. This was a scene she had fantasized about countless times.
Tang Zhanyue used what he had learned throughout his life and added a lot of love to make delicious three dishes and one soup, and then waited for three full hours for the news from Little D that the master would not come out to eat.
Tang Zhanyue was silent, Tang Zhanyue was sad and angry, Tang Zhanyue was angry and ate three dishes and one soup!
Sure enough, in the eyes of her parents, she was an accident!
Tang Zhanyue was full, but she was not in the mood to exercise today. After washing, she lay down on the bed and soon fell asleep.
When I opened my eyes again, it was already the next morning.
Probably because his long-cherished wish finally came true, Tang Zhanyue was in better shape than ever before. When he sent Ye Zheng a good morning message, he also included a photo of the garden.
Ye Zheng was keenly aware of her mood and took advantage of the few minutes before training to call her.
Tang Zhanyue answered instantly, not caring that he didn't even wash his face.
Ye Zheng looked at her glowing eyes and slightly raised the corners of his lips, becoming more and more sure of his guess, "What good happened?"
Tang Zhanyue tilted his head and smiled, "A wish came true." She didn't want to talk more, so she asked casually: "Are you in the military department?"
"Well, I'm going back to the front line in half a month." Ye Zheng was very reluctant, "Let's have dinner together tonight?"
Tang Zhanyue responded happily: "Okay."
Ye Zheng looked gentle, "See you tonight, Yueyue."
When Tang Zhanyue went downstairs, as expected, her parents were still missing, but her mood was much calmer. She finished breakfast by herself and went to work under the escort of Su Miao and Xu Feng.
